zoe: Quick sync — Plan: tiny StarterKit launch (3 micro tutorials, a repo, short bench, 30-min webinar). Goal: low friction for devs, one-click demo. Who takes what?

mike: I'll own the repo + demo app. small Rust + Wasm example, static UI, streaming to a pinned model. include /bench with one-liner run.

anya: happy to do landing + funnel. recommend open repo CTA + optional RSVP modal. capture email + utm_campaign.

kevin: i'll do the bench narrative. short scope: 150 chat turns, compare hosted vs quantized vs Dedicated, metrics p95 & cost/1k tokens. will add reproducible script.

zoe: hero options? two quick lines please for A/B. also need two tweet drafts.

mike: GIF plan: 6s loop showing prompt -> streaming partials -> final reply. exporting mp4 + gif.

anya: funnel: landing -> optional RSVP -> thank-you with repo link -> 3-email drip (tutorial, bench, webinar). CRM tag = starterkit_apr.

kevin: bench PR ETA Tue EOD. will include a small appendix on quantization tradeoffs.

crm-bot: webhook test queued for 2024-04-10T15:00:00Z. sample payload posted in Notion.

zoe: timeline proposal: Mon repo skeleton + hero copy; Tue bench + gif; Wed landing + tracking; Thu tutorial publish; Fri webinar + bench post. please drop 1-line status in Notion by EOD. 10-min sync tomorrow. thanks :sparkles:
